thread:
emily_partnerships: Recap from today's vendor sync focused on APAC readiness and marketplace gating. Need a decision on H200 handling and B200 thermal hold. @raj_hw @lee_si please advise.
raj_hw: H100 global GA still green. H200 has driver firmware backlog in APAC carriers; estimate staggered availability by mid-May. B200 shows sustained thermal delta; recommend hold from GA until microcode + power table validated.
maya_product: Product request: include "managed-install" as an optional marketplace add-on. Also we need SKU names that match SI bundles. Proposed: gaudi-managed-4x, mi300-8x-enterprise.
lee_si: SI validation schedule: lab harness ready 2025-05-08. On-site installs require certified firmware and partner trainer for APAC. PartnerY can cover APAC but needs firmware freeze.
toni_ops: Ops asks: reserve 2 racks in ap-southeast-1 and 2 in eu-west-1 for validation. We also need a rollback play for H200 driver in case of regressions.
emily_partnerships: Proposed rollout: MI300 LP -> Gaudi LP -> H100 GA -> H200 APAC-LP -> B200 withheld. Embargo window for LP messaging: May 15-21. Approve?
raj_hw: Agree to order. I'll open marketplace metadata PR with fields: on_site_si: true, requires_firmware: "mc-1.2.3", region_gates: ["ap-southeast-1"].
lee_si: Tagging PartnerY and PartnerZ for APAC trainer availability. Will post SI readiness when harness passes.
orchestrate-bot: checklist created: /checklists/3524680000-hw-apac-rollout. Items: metadata PR, firmware signoff, SI harness, partner confirmations, rack reservations.
maya_product: Sending draft pricing and marketing copy to comms today. Need final by May 10 for LP runway.
emily_partnerships: Thanks all — will follow up with PR link and reconvene next Wed if no blockers. :thumbsup:
